cases.handshake-direct-rig: Strongest recovered semantic sample; research only. Open hands, foot and contact defects remain.
cases.handshake-finger-pose: Subtle authored finger curl; not a verified grip. Body source unchanged.
cases.handshake-native-twist: No clear visual gain over baseline; optional experiment only.
cases.embrace-direct-rig: Rejected: compressed/intersecting bodies late, incomplete exit.
cases.waltz-direct-rig: Rejected: weak footwork and loose hand contact.
cases.fresh-captures/assist42-authored-rig: Rejected: does not clearly help a fallen partner stand.
cases.fresh-captures/dodge42-authored-rig: Rejected on full-sequence contact sheet: loose sparring, poor attack range.
cases.fresh-captures/highfive42-authored-rig: Rejected on full-sequence contact sheet: separate boxing-like gestures, no high-five.

limitations: No verified surface grip or collision solver
Source foot sliding and changing bone lengths remain
Scene is actual generated city but only a backdrop
InterGen noncommercial research license
InterMask comparison limited to two samples

handshake-direct-rig.capture_kind: Native InterGen raw 22-joint diagnostic WebGL replay

authored_rig.method: authored inverse binds and skin weights; exact native22 joint positions; segment-affine source-proportion fitting
limitations: No contact solver or foot locking; native coordinates are retained.
Limb lengths follow source anatomy including its framewise length variation; authored mesh proportions are intentionally adapted.
Twist uses source bend planes with a temporal fallback near straight limbs; fingers retain authored rest pose.
Mesh skin blending can change visible surface contact despite exact joint endpoints.

handshake-direct-rig.render_roundtrip_scope: Browser WebGL get_render roundtrip; not playback FPS
handshake-direct-rig.note: One render per exact source frame in order. Mannequin is display geometry around raw joints, not a textured human or native Core animation.
